user.title: Connect to SolarEdge ONE
user.description: Enter your SolarEdge ONE API credentials. The API key is required; the account key is only needed for Fleet accounts.

data_description.plan_type: Choose 'Fleet' for a My Fleet token or 'Site owner' for a single-site token.

select_site.title: Select a site
select_site.description: Choose which site to add. Add the integration again to add more sites.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SolarEdge ONE
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials are no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication. Check your API key.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to SolarEdge. Try again.

abort.no_sites: No new sites are available for this account.

init.title: Rate limiting & credit budget
init.description: Control how often SolarEdge ONE is polled so you stay within your plan's monthly credits and per-minute call limit.

data_description.monthly_credit_budget: Total API credits your plan allows per month (My Fleet default: 2000).
data_description.calls_per_minute: Maximum API calls per minute your plan allows (default: 10).
data_description.budget_safety_factor: Fraction of the monthly budget to actually spend, leaving headroom (default: 0.7).

over_budget.title: SolarEdge ONE credit budget may be exceeded
over_budget.description: At the current polling rate this site is projected to use about {projected} API credits this month, above your budget of {budget}. Polling has been slowed automatically. Increase the budget or reduce enabled data in the integration options if this is unexpected.
